channel.title: EVENTFAQS Media Pvt - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from EVENTFAQS Media Pvt (eventfaqs.com)

item.title: India Unveils Bharat Pavilion at European Film Market 2026 in Berlin
item.description: India launched the Bharat Pavilion at EFM 2026 in Berlin, spotlighting global collaboration led by the National Film Development Corporation.

item.title: Bacardi Brings Caribbean-Inspired Celebration to Life with Tropical Edition in Goa
item.description: Bacardi debuted its first-ever Tropical Edition in Goa, transforming W Goa into an immersive celebration of music, culture, and community-inspired experiences.

item.title: Love in Full Bloom: Brookfield Properties Unveils Kyoto-Inspired Valentine Experiences in NCR
item.description: A Kyoto-inspired celebration by Brookfield Properties transforms NCR venues into immersive, wedding-ready romantic spaces this Valentine’s weekend.

item.title: India’s LegaXy Enters MENA, Partners with Optima Sports and Capital, Launches Ahmad Skaik as Exclusive Athlete
item.description: Under the partnership, LegaXy and Optima will build a sports management ecosystem in MENA, including athlete representation, brand partnerships, and original content.

item.title: Éclat Studios Returns Second Time in a Row as End-to-End TV Production Partner for SBI Life SpellBee in association with Mirchi Season 15
item.description: Éclat Studios handled the end-to-end production of SBI Life SpellBee Season 15 for the second consecutive year, reinforcing its consistency and execution-led trust in managing the national broadcast IP.

item.title: Delhi Khel Mahakumbh 2026 Launched in Capital, Shikhar Dhawan Pledges Support for Grassroots Talent
item.description: Shikhar Dhawan reaffirmed his commitment to grassroots sports as Delhi Khel Mahakumbh 2026 was launched at Chhatrasal Stadium, with Da One Group joining as Sports Development Partner.

item.title: Effie India Awards 2025 Celebrates 25th Edition; NESTLE India Ltd and Leo India Take Top Honours
item.description: The 25th Effie India Awards honoured NESTLE India Ltd as Client of the Year and Leo India as Agency of the Year, with McCann Gurugram securing the Grand Effie for its Maggi campaign.

item.title: Kala Literature Awards 2026 Concludes with Focus on Dialogue, Inclusion and Cultural Responsibility
item.description: Kala Literature Festival 2026 concluded with the Kala Literature Awards, spotlighting literary excellence and reaffirming its vision of dialogue-driven, inclusive cultural engagement.

item.title: ULI India Expands Annual Conference 2026 with Focus on Leadership, Policy and Resilient Cities
item.description: ULI India’s 2026 Annual Conference will bring together global and domestic leaders to examine policy, capital and innovation shaping the future of Indian cities.

item.title: Goa Carnaval 2026 Begins with Grand Curtain Raiser in Porvorim
item.description: Goa Carnaval 2026 began in Porvorim with a traditional bullock cart procession led by King Momo, setting the stage for five days of celebrations across the State.
